notes: attempt-1 was exploratory (variable summaries, complete-case counts; no RESULT lines). Final run: Table 1 via OLS (fixest, country-clustered SEs) of personal / programmatic on ev_total with party covariates (partysize, unions, business, religious) and country covariates (pluralty, pr, cl as factor, mdmh, polity, demsys, system as factor, gdppc, gini, ethfrac); complete-case sample gives 431 parties in 75 countries. Low/high volatility = 25th/75th percentile of ev_total in the estimation sample (Stata-like quantile type 2). Ethnic party = ethnic > 0.5 (majority of coders report ties); ethnic model adds ethnic_d and its interaction with ev_total. Ideology model adds extremist2 and its interaction (430 obs, one party missing extremist2); moderate = 0, extremist = 3. Differences in predicted values are linear combinations of coefficients, independent of covariate values. Brazil RD: rdrobust defaults (local linear, triangular kernel, mserd bandwidth) on the open-seat sample dlameduck_runs == 0; conventional point estimate reported. RD reproduces Table 2 exactly (h, b, N, CIs match). No claim comparison was used to modify the script.
